*Reserve Cameras* (high-end cinema/DSLR cameras like the Canon C100, C200, XF300, RP, Sony FX3, Blackmagic Pocket Cinema 6K Pro):

• Must be returned to the RMC desk any time before closing on the last day of the reservation
• Late returns may result in overdue fees on your library account
• Initial training + consultation is required before your first reservation (see the RMC User Training LibGuide)
• You must book in advance via LibCal — <https://cal.lib.virginia.edu/equipment?lid=241|Reserve equipment at RMC>
